description: This file contains unit tests for the FeatureModified class in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.things package. It tests immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and resource path logic related to FeatureModified instances.

classes.name: FeatureModifiedTest
classes.description: Unit test class for FeatureModified, testing immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, null handling, and resource path generation.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that FeatureModified instances are immutable and that Feature is also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the equals and hashCode methods of FeatureModified using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Ensures that creating FeatureModified with a null ThingId string throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Ensures that creating FeatureModified with a null ThingId object throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeature
methods.description: Ensures that creating FeatureModified with a null feature throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toJson method returns the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating a FeatureModified instance from valid JSON.

methods.name: createInstanceFromJsonWithNullFeature
methods.description: Tests creating a FeatureModified instance from JSON where the feature is null.

methods.name: getResourcePathReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getResourcePath returns the expected JsonPointer.
